summary: Remote changes are routed to the exact folder that owns the file; repeated failures back off, and the push heartbeat keeps the connection honest.
changelog: A notify_file_id push hint is resolved against each folder's sync journal, so only the folder that owns the file re-syncs instead of every folder of the account (issue #183).
A folder that keeps failing backs off (10/30/60s) before re-running instead of hammering the server (issue #184).
While the account's push channel is connected, the periodic remote-interval poll is skipped - push is already real-time (issue #185).
The push WebSocket detects dead connections via a heartbeat (no activity for 75s reconnects) and stops retrying after 3 failed auth attempts, parking in AuthRequired (issue #186).
